## In progress

- `1.8.2` `Bytes`-like slice abstraction unifying mmap, heap and remote-cached buffers (`ByteSource`) (M1)
- `1.8.3` ADR documenting the unsafe boundary + SIGBUS strategy (M1)

## Ready next (first 15 todo leaves whose milestone deps are done)

- `1.11.3` Coverage report (`cargo llvm-cov`) uploaded as artifact, no gating yet (M1)
